description: Create an instance of any class (Part, Model, Folder, RemoteEvent, ScreenGui, TextLabel, ...), with properties and children. One undo step. Values are plain JSON and are converted to the property's own type: Vector3 [x,y,z], Vector2 [x,y], Color3 "#RRGGBB" or [r,g,b] (0-255), CFrame {"position":[x,y,z],"rotation":[rx,ry,rz]} in degrees (or just [x,y,z] to move it), UDim2 [xScale,xOffset,yScale,yOffset], enums by name ("Neon"), BrickColor by name, instances by path.

children.description: Nested instances to create inside it, each {class_name, name?, properties?, attributes?, children?}.

name.description: Name of the new instance. Optional.

parent_path.description: Where to put it. Instance path such as "game.Workspace.Model.Part" or "game.ServerScriptService.Main". Services are found by name.

properties.description: Property name to value, applied before parenting.

name: studio_create_instance
